theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 5 (Cinematic/Premium) with a touch of Archetype 4 (High-Contrast) for Car Mode readability
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Sottovoce requires an immersive, emotional experience for lyrics reading (dark, cinematic, glowing accents) paired with extreme clarity and high contrast for Car Mode safety.

font_family.instruction: Install via expo-font: @expo-google-fonts/outfit. Use for both headings and body to create a sleek, cohesive, musical feel.

MicButton.layout: Huge circular button centered on home screen.
MicButton.interaction: Tap to start ~9s recording. Wraps with multiple animated View rings using react-native-reanimated that scale outward and fade out while recording.

TrackCard.layout: Album art (left) + Track Info (right) + Match Confidence.
TrackCard.shadows: Elevation 4 on Android, ShadowOpacity 0.1 on iOS

KaraokeLine.layout: Individual lyric line in the ScrollView.

Tabs.layout: Segmented control for view modes (Original / Translation / Both).

Splash.description: App entry point. Displays logo against the dynamic abstract background. Language picker appears if first launch.

Home.description: Minimalist centered layout. Huge Mic button in center. Secondary 'Manual Input' text button below. Top right: History & Settings icons.

Recording.description: Visual feedback state. Mic button pulses. Text 'Listening...' with a ~9s progress indicator.

layout.body: Reanimated ScrollView of Lyrics. If 'Both' is selected, display flex-row side-by-side on tablet/car mode, or alternating lines (Bold Original, Regular Translation) on portrait mobile.

Car_Mode.description: Landscape forced. Removes heavy UI. Shows only Track title, massive active Lyric, and previous/next lyric.
Car_Mode.overrides: Use car_mode_scale typography. Force dark mode or ultra-high contrast light mode. Touch targets minimum 64x64.

History.description: Chronological list of identified tracks. Swipe-to-delete row action.

iconography.usage: Use stroke-width 2.5 for a bold, legible look. No emojis.

technical_rules.styling: Use pure React Native StyleSheet. Do not use Tailwind or CSS files.
technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='mic-record-button').
